questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding intraoperative findings for treatment of large bowel obstruction is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: A distended caecum during laparotomy indicates a large bowel obstruction.

options.label: B
options.text: Emergency caecostomy can be done to stabilize the patient.

options.label: C
options.text: A collapsed caecum during laparotomy suggests a large bowel obstruction.

options.label: D
options.text: Resection and anastomosis are appropriate treatments for Crohn's disease
